name: bounded-two-hop-evidence-v1
selection: Train/validation only; first two stages including original test/OOD and confirmation-101/307/911 are seen regression. No current-stage test or confirmation evaluated before this freeze.

chosen.reason: All capped variants reach 81/81 on validation. cap2 adds the fewest actual edge checks, while lowering GA/hybrid mean expansions from 4.44/4.46 to 4.11; extra cap4 benefit is only two expansions over all 81 queries at additional evidence reads. Retain earlier-stage weak sector proxy outside a measured suffix rather than neutralising it, which did not help validation.
chosen.llm_fusion: Retain raw scores and weight 2.0; fix unscored neutral 0.5 to mean zero adjustment. Center at 0.5 and bound signed adjustment to +/-1.0; do not clamp negative evidence preference away for the zero-weight ablation. Neutral/no-score invariance is a correctness requirement, not a claimed model accuracy gain. Validation shows tied success/work across 0.25–2.0, so no weight increase or test-driven selection.
chosen.llm_legality: Do not tune a threshold: validation illegal examples at pTrue 0.79 overlap eligible 0.75–0.82. Rules remain an independent evidence firewall; raw model misses are retained.
chosen.freeze_note: Protocol and sources will be hashed before any current test/OOD/new-seed run.

limits: Bounded extra evidence improves branch ranking at additional probe and edge-scan cost. Does not promise any finite-budget completeness. Synthetic fixed-relation retrieval; repeated validation can overfit. Tiny 0.5B LLM is fallible; measured legality, raw explanation failures and search regressions must be retained. New seed confirmation is one-shot; later use is regression only.
